IndiGo Flight Diverted to Lucknow After Cargo Smoke Alarm

An IndiGo flight traveling from Agartala to Delhi made an emergency landing in Lucknow on Tuesday after a smoke alarm activated in the cargo compartment. The aircraft, an Airbus A320, landed safely at Lucknow Airport. Emergency services were present at the airport as a precautionary measure. The airline has not yet released a statement regarding the incident or the cause of the alarm. All passengers and crew are reported to be safe.
